about.metaDescription: A typing test built around music: every correct key plays the next note of a real piano piece, a mistake plays nothing. No account, all in the browser.
about.masthead: Type it right. The note lands.
about.lead: A full typing test (many modes, progress tracked session after session, themes, sounds, instant feedback on every typo), built around one idea: music. Every correct keystroke fires the next note of a real piano piece; a mistake plays nothing, never a wrong note. Your ear catches the slip before your eyes do, and the piece only sounds right when you type right. You practise longer, without watching a clock, because the reward is not a number: it is a melody taking shape under your fingers.

manifesto.heading: The manifesto
manifesto.body: The score only moves when you type it right. The piece already exists in full; your typing is the baton.
manifesto.correctDesc: the next note of the piece plays.
manifesto.wrongDesc: nothing. Never a wrong note, only silence.
manifesto.backspaceDesc: the mistake is cleared and the music resumes under a veil of reverb.
manifesto.tempoDesc: follows your typing rhythm. The octave keeps a fixed pattern per word: only the tempo reacts.

music.heading: The music
music.body: Pieces are read from real public-domain MIDI files, then rendered by a sequencer that advances one note at a time. No loop, no pasted sample: it is the whole piece, revealed as you type.

modes.heading: The modes
modes.classicDesc: Type as much as you can over a chosen duration: 15, 30, 60 or 120 seconds.
modes.sprintDesc: A word count to reach: 10, 25, 50 or 100.
modes.quoteDesc: A full quotation, credited to its author and its work.
modes.zenDesc: No timer, no word goal. You move at your own pace.
modes.codeDesc: Real code snippets, punctuation and digits included.
modes.learningDesc: Five progressive levels, from the home row to the full keyboard.
modes.ghostDesc: A cursor replays your best record while you type.
modes.customDesc: Your own texts, pasted once and kept in the browser.

corpus.heading: The corpus
corpus.body: Five text collections: literature, poetry, philosophy, gaming, code. Everything is public domain or royalty-free: author dead for more than seventy years, verifiable source (Wikisource, Project Gutenberg), language noted for every entry. The full criteria are in the repository's CONTRIBUTING file.

local.heading: Local first, no account
local.body: No sign-up, no server, no tracking. Your sessions, your records and your personal texts live in your browser, through IndexedDB. You can export all of it, or import it back, from the <settings>settings</settings>.

shortcuts.heading: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.encore: From the results screen, start a new test.
shortcuts.backspace: Fix the last mistake. The music resumes under a veil of reverb.
shortcuts.escape: Close an open panel: piece selector, personal texts.

glossary.heading: Glossary
glossary.wpmDesc: Gross words per minute: the number of characters typed divided by five, per minute. Every keystroke counts, right or wrong.
glossary.wpmNetDesc: The same calculation, but only correct characters count. A mistake is never penalised twice.
glossary.accuracyDesc: The share of correct keystrokes out of every keystroke in the session.
glossary.consistencyDesc: How steady your pace is. The session is split into five-second windows; the closer the speeds are from one window to the next, the higher the consistency.

about.closing: Enough reading. Back to the keyboard.
